source_note: Task shape extracted from the launchpad smoke suite (scripts/ci/launchpad_k8s_smoke.sh; hermes runs a single-turn query through an OpenAI-compatible provider and passes when the run completes). The smoke's own pass criterion is completion (exit 0); the deterministic content checks below are an extension recorded per HELM-618 so the parity bar measures answer quality, not just liveness. The selection/holdout split is fixed here, before any capture.
